qc.label_under_test: In step-by-step instructions addressed to the reader (web forms, documents, medicines), the 'and' / 'and then' that chains a second action after a first, and that next step's verb (e.g. 'register online and then print'); the same chain told as a story or past-tense narration stays low.

neighbours.label: The verb 'print' (or 'download') as the next step after 'and then' in a procedure, in instructions or story; other next-step verbs fire weaker
fire: Fill in the form, save it, and then print it so you can sign it by hand.
Open the ticket confirmation email and then print the boarding pass before you leave for the airport.
She edited the essay one last time and then printed three copies for the committee.
Choose the template you like, enter your details, and then download the finished PDF.
First select your photos, then crop them, and then print them on glossy paper.
He logged into the portal and then downloaded his tax statement for the year.
Click the Export button and then print the report from the preview window.
To get the map, zoom in on the trail area and then download it for offline use.
quiet: Either way, the outcome surprised everyone in the room.
The function returned a dict mapping column names to types.
Fill in the form, save it, and keep it on your computer until you sign it.
Open the ticket confirmation email before you leave for the airport.
She edited the essay one last time before the committee met.
Choose the template you like and enter your details carefully.
First select your photos, then crop them so they look balanced.
He logged into the portal to check his tax statement for the year.

predictions: Expect most fire items to pass via 'print'; 'download' items and narration may be weaker. Near misses (no 'and then print/download') should stay low.
